task: Move the macOS jobs in ci.yml, release.yml and supply-chain-fixture.yml from the macos-14 runner image to macos-15 because GitHub is retiring macos-14 on 2026-11-02 and is cancelling its jobs during brownouts

events.summary: The change replaces 'runs-on: macos-14' with 'runs-on: macos-15' on four lines: two in ci.yml, one in release.yml, one in supply-chain-fixture.yml. The ubuntu-latest workflows are untouched, no step, action ref or check was changed, and only this trace was added alongside

CI run 41318425852 on e287250 was cancelled within one second on both jobs (supply-chain, verify) and attempt 2 of the same run was cancelled the same way. The job annotation reads: scheduled macOS 14 runner image brownout, macOS 14 images retire on November 2, 2026. No step ran, so the cancellation says nothing about the code under test
macos-15 is an Apple Silicon (arm64) image like macos-14, so the Apple-Silicon-only build target is preserved. The runner label is the only thing changed

Not yet verified: the macos-15 jobs have not run. The Rust toolchain, Xcode and Homebrew versions on macos-15 differ from macos-14, so a green verify job on the pushed commit is the real evidence and is checked after push. Locally only the diff was inspected
The four macos-14 runner labels now say macos-15; whether the pipeline passes on macos-15 is not claimed here and the release.yml job is not exercised by this push
Progress: runner labels changed; the next blocker is observing CI on macos-15 after push
